arms.astra: One call answers every item directly from the archived blocks.
arms.harness: One call returns exact wording for the needed figures; code verifies each quote, reads the amount and computes every item. Unproven figures leave dependent items unknown.

grading.amount: within 1% of gold, floor one hundredth of the case precision
grading.ratio: within 1% of gold, floor 0.01 percentage point
grading.case: exact when every item is correct

primary: Case-level exact rate per arm. Per case the majority of repeats decides; paired cases are compared with an exact two-sided McNemar test on discordant cases.
stop: Calls run one at a time, repeat by repeat. A 429, usage limit or capacity error waits for the announced cooldown up to 900 seconds and retries that call once; a second availability error stops dispatch. Other failures count as wrong answers.
pilot_purpose: Pilot cases come from announcements used in earlier benchmarks and seen during design. They estimate ceiling and discordance only; the holdout size is set from them and holdout issuers must be new.
